sections.name: Diablos gang
sections.card:
Summary: A small Latin American gang that holds the Hepburn Heights district of Portland and is not well armed.
Weak points: They are poorly armed: in Grand Theft Auto III they use only baseball bats on the street, and guns appear only in missions.
Looks like: Members come in two kinds: a red bandana, light blue jeans and a dark blue jacket, or a blue bandana, a dark blue jacket and olive cargo pants.
Tips: Their gang car is the Diablo Stallion, in every game they appear in. The Uptown Yardies are their arch rivals.

sections.name: Triad gang
sections.card:
Summary: A Chinese criminal gang that controls the Chinatown and Callahan Point areas of Portland.
Weak points: The page gives no weak point; members carry baseball bats or pistols.
Looks like: Blue boiler suits and black bandannas.
Tips: They are enemies of the Leone Family and have a fierce rivalry with it.

sections.name: Leone Family (the Mafia)
sections.card:
Summary: The Italian mafia of Portland, based mostly in Saint Mark's with interests in the Red Light District, Chinatown and Trenton; the wiki calls it the most dangerous gang because of its shotguns.
Weak points: The page gives no weak point; what to respect is their powerful shotguns, which can easily blow up a normal car in two shots.
Looks like: Henchmen wear black suits, some with sunglasses, and their gang car, the Mafia Sentinel, is gray in Grand Theft Auto III.
Tips: Do not drive within range of their shotguns: they make quick work of vehicles. They have a fierce rivalry with the Triads.

sections.name: Colombian Cartel
sections.card:
Summary: A Colombian drug cartel that took parts of Staunton Island and Shoreside Vale and is heavily involved in the drugs trade.
Weak points: The page gives no weak point; it calls the Cartel exceptionally well armed.
Looks like: In Grand Theft Auto III members wear Hawaiian shirts, combat pants, Akruba-style hats and cowboy boots.
Tips: Their gang car in Grand Theft Auto III is the Cartel Cruiser. Their main enemies are the Leone Family and the Yakuza.

sections.name: Uptown Yardies
sections.card:
Summary: A Jamaican gang based on Staunton Island that is found only in Newport and also deals around Liberty Campus.
Weak points: The page gives no weak point; members carry baseball bats in Grand Theft Auto III.
Looks like: A black short-sleeved hoodie, tan vest and pants, and brown shoes; both kinds of member look the same.
Tips: Their cars are Yardie Lobo lowriders, which are unique in Grand Theft Auto III for their hydraulic suspension. The Diablos are their rivals.

sections.name: Military (the Army)
sections.card:
Summary: At a six-star wanted level the Army chases you with soldiers, Barracks OL trucks for pursuit and roadblocks, and Rhino tanks for pursuit.
Weak points: Soldiers are always armed with M16s, but only two spawn near each Barracks OL at a roadblock, so they are less lethal than SWAT or the FBI. A Rhino shrugs off small arms fire; explosives, molotov cocktails and the flamethrower can damage it.
Tips: Soldiers drop grenades when killed in Grand Theft Auto III. Law enforcement tends not to use the Rhino's main cannon.
